'''Vemec''' was a [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]]. He was involved in negotiations with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] over taxation of [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] [[Hyperwave/Legends|hyperwave]] broadcasts into the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="DP" />
